title: National PAN Leaders to Rally Behind Sen. Imelda Sanmiguel at Her Nov. 30 Report in Nuevo Laredo

content:
National leaders of Mexico's National Action Party (PAN) will travel to Nuevo Laredo on Monday, Nov. 30, to attend Sen. Imelda Sanmiguel's legislative report, in a show of national backing for her leadership in Tamaulipas.

Attending will be Ricardo Anaya, the PAN's national coordinator, and Jorge Romero, the party's national president, according to Noreste Digital, which reported the visit Nov. 22.

The visit is framed as a show of national support for Sanmiguel's leadership in Tamaulipas and her political project, the outlet reported.

Sanmiguel said the meeting will let her share the results of her legislative work and bring national leaders closer to Nuevo Laredo's needs and challenges. She highlighted her coordination with Anaya in defending Mexicans' interests, according to the report.

The report is presented as both an accountability event — a senator reporting back on her work — and a positioning moment for Sanmiguel within Tamaulipas PAN politics ahead of coming electoral challenges, according to the outlet's analysis.

Webb Watch 956 previously covered Sanmiguel's reported interest in the Nuevo Laredo mayor's race in 2027, in an Oct. 22 story. The Nov. 30 event is a new development, not a repeat of that coverage.

The venue and time of the Nov. 30 event were not given in the report, and no independent confirmation from the PAN's national office or from Sanmiguel's own channels was found. Webb Watch 956 will update this story if those details are confirmed.

Source: Noreste Digital, Nov. 22, 2026.
